title: Before you join: an unpaid test of a new service
lede: person.tools is a service that is not launched yet. In it, an AI agent asks people for their reaction to something it is working on: a song, a page, a game. You are invited to an unpaid test of it.

sections.label: Unpaid
sections.text: You are not paid for this test. Every call says UNPAID TEST before you take it.

sections.label: An AI asks
sections.text: Every call is written and sent by an AI agent working for the person or team named on that call (for this test, the person.tools team). Before each call you see who is responsible for it, how many minutes it takes, and what will be recorded. You can say no to any call, with no mark against you.

sections.label: What is recorded
sections.text: During a call: when the sound or video plays and pauses, whether the page is in front, how long you take, your answers, and whether each answer was typed or pasted. Not recorded: your voice, your camera, your location, your contacts.

sections.label: What the agent gets
sections.text: Your answers and a short summary of that record (for example, how much of the sound played), under an id that is different for every asker. Never anything that says who you are, and never the step-by-step log of each play, pause and skip.

sections.label: What is shown in public
sections.text: For calls the person.tools team's own programs make, a public page of real calls shows when each was answered, what kind of call it was, how many people answered, and the one line the asker wrote about what it changed. Never your name, and never your words, unless you say yes to that quote.

sections.label: Your answers and AI training
sections.text: Each call says, before you take it, whether the asker may use your written answers to train AI. Your voice is never used to train anything.

sections.label: When you are rung
sections.text: Only when you turn On. You start Off. No calls between 9 PM and 8 AM your time unless you change it. Two missed calls turn you Off again. An ask's alert says only who is asking, never what they wrote, unless you turn on “Show the ask in my alerts” in your settings; then it may show the ask's first line, up to 80 characters. Your phone's own preview setting still decides what shows on a locked screen.

sections.label: Stop, leave, delete
sections.text: Stop any call at any time. "Stop: this upset me" ends it and reports it. On your page, one tap deletes your account, answers and records; you can save your receipts first. Deleted from the service at once, and from every copy within 30 days.

sections.label: How long we keep it
sections.text: Your answers up to 13 months; the detailed record of a call (when it played or paused, whether the page was in front) 30 days; or less if you delete them. If the test ends with nobody to run the service, everything about you is deleted when it ends.

sections.label: Who to reach
sections.text: Use "Report this call" before you take a call, or "Stop or report" at the top of any call screen. Or reply to the person who sent you this link: during this test, that person runs person.tools and is the one who sees your answers.

sections.label: Adults only
sections.text: This test is for adults in the United States.

footnote: This notice is what holds during the test, and every promise on it is kept. The service's longer terms and privacy notice are still drafts and are not in force.
accept: I am 18 or over, I live in the United States, and I agree to join this unpaid test
